fig1_dipole_pattern.svg: Angular distribution of electric-dipole radiation from dipole_angular_power, normalized to its peak. The two lobes are the cross-section of the doughnut pattern: power is maximal broadside (theta=90 deg) and vanishes along the dipole axis (theta=0,180 deg).
fig2_power_law.svg: Total radiated power versus frequency on log-log axes. The closed-form dipole_radiated_power (line) and the sphere integral of the angular pattern total_power_from_pattern (dots) agree, and the slope of 4 shows the strong omega^{4} dependence -- why higher frequencies radiate far more efficiently.
